validity.researcher_notes: The history book gives 401 km for the whole line from Shkapovo to Magnitogorsk through Ishimbay. The sheet row is 192 km, which would be the first part. The book does not confirm or contradict it.

fills.researcher_notes: The operator's history book gives 401 km for the whole Shkapovo, Ishimbay and Magnitogorsk gas pipeline, built in two directions at once, Shkapovo to Ishimbay and Ishimbay to Magnitogorsk. It does not give the length of the Shkapovo to Ishimbay part alone. The 401 km figure is for the whole line, so it is not a reference for the 192 km on the sheet. The sheet value stays.

The operator's history book, read through the May 2022 archived copy, says a state commission was formed on 2 September 1958 to test and accept the Shkapovo, Ishimbay and Magnitogorsk pipeline into service, and that the line was being handed over that year. The sheet start year of 1958 is the same. The page speaks of the whole line, which includes this part, so the tier is medium.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The book describes the line being accepted into service in 1958 and says nothing about its present state. The harvested citation does not settle the status.
